body_markdown:
Nafiisa N'guessan


May 20, 2026


# Djamo Premium = Visa Platinum: the world is yours


What if your card did much more than just pay?


With Djamo Premium, your card becomes a **Visa Platinum** and unlocks a new generation of perks: travel discounts, shopping privileges, international protection, and exclusive services.


For just **2,000 F a month** , you change tier.


## 1. Travel and stay in style


Why pay full price when luxury is within reach? Thanks to our partnerships with Visa, your Djamo Premium card becomes your best travel agent.


### Top-tier hotels


Get up to **12% off on Agoda** , **8% off on Booking.com** , and up to **20% across the IHG network** (InterContinental, Holiday Inn).


For something truly exceptional, the **Visa Luxury Hotel Collection** unlocks 900 elite properties around the world.


### Freedom to move


Whether it’s a business trip to Paris or a family getaway, hit the road with ease.


Get preferential rates and up to **10% off at Avis, SIXT, and Rentalcars** - more than 60,000 rental points worldwide.


## 2. Shopping & lifestyle


The world becomes your playground. Passing through Paris, London, or Milan? Your Premium status opens the doors of the best addresses.


### Printemps Haussmann


A welcome reserved for Premium guests, a **5% discount** , and a stop at the tea salon on the house.


### The Bicester Collection


Exclusive savings at Europe’s most famous outlet villages, including **La Vallée Village** - designer pieces at friendlier prices.


## 3. Protection for every purchase


Because the unexpected should never spoil your memories, Djamo Premium puts an invisible shield around you.


### Automatic purchase protection


Bought something you love over 100 USD? It’s automatically insured against theft, accidental damage, and delivery issues.


You buy, we protect.


### Emergency assistance (GCAS)


Lost your card or need cash mid-trip? Visa’s international service has you covered **24/7, in more than 200 countries** - even if you’ve lost access to your app.


## Ready to move up?


A single hotel booking or car rental can pay for several months of your subscription.


Add **0.5% back on every payment** and **free transfers** , and the Premium plan doesn’t cost you a thing - it pays you back.


Activation is instant. Open the “Premium Plan” section of your Djamo app and unlock your new global perks today.
